# Vendored

- `marked.esm.js`: [marked](https://github.com/markedjs/marked) 18.1.1, `lib/marked.esm.js` from the npm package as published (MIT, see `marked.LICENSE`). The page renders READMEs with it, with raw HTML shown as text.

The fonts in `../fonts/` are Spectral, Public Sans and JetBrains Mono (SIL Open Font License), the same files as Stoa's.
